title: Verifier checklist grades a second pre-existing chart ('Invoice Dollars Burndown August 2023' on the Dollars sheet) not mentioned in the prompt, and the verifier's fit-to-one-page rendering shrinks that sheet's chart to an illegible 119x81 thumbnail due to stray whitespace cells in the input workbook
evidence: The prompt (`problem.py`) instructs the agent only to: 'Create a Line chart in the Count sheet titled "Invoice Count Burndown August 2023"'. However, 6 of the 28 checklist items in `spec.yaml` (items 23-28, 21.4% of the checklist) grade a different chart on the `Dollars` sheet: 'For chart "Invoice Dollars Burndown August 2023": ...'. Worse, in both `Task 1411527_input.xlsx` and `gt_Task 1411527_golden.xlsx`, the `Dollars` sheet (`xl/worksheets/sheet2.xml`) contains stray whitespace strings in cells `I34` (32,767 spaces) and `K36` (8,568 spaces). When `verify_spreadsheetbench2_chart_checklist` calls `_fit_to_one_page` (`fitToWidth=1, fitToHeight=1`), LibreOffice scales the `Dollars` sheet down to fit the 32,767-character width onto a single page, shrinking the `Dollars` sheet table and chart into a tiny, completely illegible 119x81 pixel region (`Page 2: raw=(935, 1210), cropped=(119, 81)`). Consequently, items 23-28 automatically fail on every run (units 1, 2, and 3 all failed items 23-28), reducing the maximum achievable checklist score from 28/28 to 22/28 (0.786 vs the >0.70 pass threshold) before the agent's chart is even evaluated.
confirmation: Checklist items 23-28 grade 'Invoice Dollars Burndown August 2023', which the prompt never mentions, and they fail in every trial of run <id>. The Dollars sheet's I34/K36 whitespace strings (32,767 and 8,568 characters) explain the unreadable fit-to-page render.
fix: Verifier parameters: dropped checklist items 23-28. They grade the pre-existing 'Invoice Dollars Burndown August 2023' chart on the Dollars sheet, which the prompt never mentions, and fit-to-page renders that sheet as a 119x81 speck because of whitespace strings in Dollars!I34 and K36, so the items failed in every trial. The checklist is now the 22 items on the requested Count chart (same threshold, > 0.7), and the same 6 lines are removed from the grader guidance.

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official chart checklist: verify_spreadsheetbench2_chart_checklist renders the pre-existing Dollars chart as an unreadable 119x81 image and causes false negatives on units 1 and 3
evidence: In `spreadsheetbench2_charts.py`, `_chart_only_copy` checks `if b"/drawing" in entries.get(_rels_path(sheet_path), b"")` (which matches all three sheets: `Count`, `Dollars`, and `Data` because `Data` has a `vmlDrawing`) and applies `_fit_to_one_page` to all of them. Because `Dollars` has 32,767 spaces in cell `I34`, LibreOffice shrinks the entire `Dollars` sheet into a 119x81 pixel speck on Page 2, causing checklist items 23-28 (6 of 28 items) to fail unconditionally on every unit (`Failed items: [..., 23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28]`). Because 6/28 items are automatically lost, the agent must pass at least 20 of the remaining 22 items (90.9%) on the `Count` chart to clear the `> 0.7` (20/28) threshold. In units 1 and 3, the agents constructed the requested line chart on the `Count` sheet with the required title, series (`Data!$G$6:$G$46` and `Data!$D$6:$D$46`), colors (grey `#A5A5A5` and blue `#5B9BD5`), Y-axis scaling (0 to 800), and angled `dd/mm/yyyy` X-axis dates, and visually verified their rendered PDFs during the trajectory (unit 1 steps [20]-[48], unit 3 steps [20]-[46]). However, because LibreOffice rendered the chart at default/compact dimensions where the vision judge could not read intermediate point values at 110 DPI, combined with the 6 guaranteed failures on `Dollars`, units 1 and 3 scored 11/28 (0.39 -> score=0) while unit 2 (which manually enlarged the chart anchor and tweaked LibreOffice chart properties via UNO in steps [57]-[69]) scored 21/28 (0.75 -> score=1).
confirmation: Input Dollars!I34 holds a 32,767-space string (K36 8,568 spaces), and checklist items 23-28 on the pre-existing Dollars chart failed in all three grade.json files, even the passing 21/28 trial. That leaves only 22 reachable items for a >0.7 bar, and two trials scored 11/28.
fix: Verifier parameters: dropped checklist items 23-28. They grade the pre-existing 'Invoice Dollars Burndown August 2023' chart on the Dollars sheet, which the prompt never mentions, and fit-to-page renders that sheet as a 119x81 speck because of whitespace strings in Dollars!I34 and K36, so the items failed in every trial. The checklist is now the 22 items on the requested Count chart (same threshold, > 0.7), and the same 6 lines are removed from the grader guidance. The finding's other part, the vision judge reading a default-size Count chart at 110 DPI, is a harness rendering matter not addressed here.
